correctness.rationale: The harmonic Poisson boundary Fourier expansion gives h2-norm^2=(1+x)/(1-x), while absolute convergence of binomial Fourier series yields angular fourth moment (1+9x+9x²+x³)/(1-x)^3. Radial integration and the displayed antiderivative yield exact normalized profile R(x); its derivative has coefficients x²/2+x³/2+sum_{k>=4}6(2k²-8k+3)x^k/[k(k-1)(k-2)(k-3)], all strictly positive. Hence R strictly increases from 1 to nonattained Poisson-family supremum 5/2 as x->1-. The cited upper bound (3+2sqrt2)/2 is imported from the 2026 theorem with exact normalized measures; no globally sharp constant is asserted. Independently quadrature-checked 7 x values, strict sample monotonicity and 3 angular fourth-moment identities. Sample checks support but do not establish coefficient positivity for all k, which the closed coefficient inequality does.
